verdict.rationale: Open WebUI can be driven programmatically. API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, a gateway exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models for running agent tasks, and a minimal `cptr run` CLI exists. It also deploys via Docker/Kubernetes, supports server-side scheduled prompts, and offers completion webhooks, but nothing documents a headless or CI-pipeline mode. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage documentation, details on what the single-command CLI does, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of CI automation.
